title: Minimum Amount of Time to Collect Garbage
summary: Given a 0-indexed array of strings garbage where garbage[i] represents the types of garbage ('M', 'P', or 'G') at the i-th house, and a 0-indexed integer array travel where travel[i] is the time in minutes needed to travel from house i to house i + 1, calculate the minimum number of minutes required for three garbage trucks to collect all the garbage.
statement: Given a 0-indexed array of strings garbage where garbage[i] represents the types of garbage ('M', 'P', or 'G') at the i-th house, and a 0-indexed integer array travel where travel[i] is the time in minutes needed to travel from house i to house i + 1, calculate the minimum number of minutes required for three garbage trucks to collect all the garbage. Each truck starts at house 0, picks up one type of garbage (metal, paper, or glass) and must visit each house in order, but they do not need to visit every house. Only one truck can operate at a time, and no truck can pick up garbage while another is in transit or collecting garbage.
constraints: Each character M, P, or G is one piece collected in one minute.
A dedicated truck for each type starts at house 0 and stops after the last house containing its type.
travel[i] is the time from house i to i+1; return total collection and necessary travel time.
hints: Count every garbage character for the collection-time total.
Record the last house containing each of M, P, and G.
Build prefix travel times from house 0 and add the prefix at each type’s last house.
Each piece must be collected once, and each truck must traverse exactly the route to its last required house, so these independent mandatory costs are sufficient.
editorial: Each piece must be collected once, and each truck must traverse exactly the route to its last required house, so these independent mandatory costs are sufficient.

tests.explanation: Six pieces take six minutes; the paper truck travels six minutes and the glass truck nine, totaling 21.
Eight pieces take eight minutes, and all three trucks travel to the last house for 39 travel minutes, totaling 47.
